title: docs(pm-dispatch): advisory_report needs the same advisory write grant as advisory_create
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xU1C787MQBQdgHEzN2hGGe1)_

Part of #29448

## What changes

Two text drifts from the card, items 1 and 2. Item 3 (the workflow comment) is a separate Tier H PR so this diff stays out of Tier H.

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/security-findings.md` §3: the `advisory_report` bullet said the row is for a repository where the App has no advisory write grant. It now says `advisory_report` and `advisory_create` mint the same advisory write grant, so a repository without it refuses both, and that a report also has a per-account daily limit. The fallback stays the existing "both refused ⇒ session hand-off" bullet two lines below. Reworded in place on one line; the file stays at 56 lines (ceiling 56) and the line is 117 bytes (budget 120).
- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs`, the header of "The four advisory rows": it pointed at `ops.mjs`'s section by its old name, "The three rows that touch a security advisory". It now names the current "The four rows that touch a security advisory", and `ops.mjs`'s separate "The one row that READS an advisory" for the `advisory_read` subsection below it. Comment only.

## Why

The code mints `repository-advisories: write` for `advisory_report` exactly as for `advisory_create` (`OPS.advisory_report.permission` is `repository-advisories` with no `grant`, pinned by `validate.mjs --self-test`), so the old bullet sent a seat to a row that dies at the mint on the very repositories it was "kept for". The `execute.mjs` cross-reference named a section heading that no longer exists in `ops.mjs`.

## Verification

- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` exit 0 (security-findings.md 56/56, no line over the byte budget), `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` exit 0, `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 42 commands for this diff; all 42 exit 0 on this head, including `check:pm-fleet-write-execute`, `check:pm-fleet-write-validate`, `check:pm-fleet-write-dispatch`, `check:scripts-symbol-anchors`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check-comment-mask-corpus` and `check:doc-formula-expressions` (after building `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint`).
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` exit 0.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

_Keep one value on each of the two lines above, each line starting with its key.
[Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum)
item 5 says what they mean._

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no formatter ran; `pnpm lint` itself was not run locally, the diff touches no linted package source)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. (the card is split in two PRs by the seat's order, both off `main`, neither stacked)
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the skill file's own text is Chinese, as the file already is)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
